referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset includes the raw and auxiliary materials, electricity and water used to manufacture CdTe Series 6 PV modules at First Solar in Malaysia. The transport of raw materials, the disposal of wastes, the infrastructure and pollutant emissions to air and water are also included.
